description: Soybean bucket-discharge tests, 2026-10-02.  Galvanised cylindrical bucket 190 mm dia x 240 mm tall, drilled bottom hole (~33 mm equivalent, see hole_contour.json), plugged with paper towel which is pulled at t_open.  Grains fall onto a conveyor belt (rubber) at drop_mm below the bucket bottom.  Masses in g are bucket contents (scale).  Video times are seconds of video time, read from 0.25-0.4 s crop strips (+-0.15 s).  Camera ~210 mm from the bucket, handheld.
grain_mm_measured_from_video: 5.0-5.4 (median blob 25 px at 0.208 mm/px, run3/run4 falling stream)

run2.note: pile on the belt grew up to the bucket bottom and stopped the flow

run3.note: recorded in slow-motion mode; the file is 120 fps with real-time timestamps (flow rate agrees with runs 1 and 4)
